definitions.gloss: government offices; public agencies; government bodies
definitions.explanation: A collective term for national government agencies and local government offices. Encompasses both central government ministries and local municipal offices.

examples.japanese: {官公庁|かんこうちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{届|とど}け{出|で}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: To submit a notification to a government office.

examples.japanese: {官公庁|かんこうちょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{土日|どにち}→土日：12082_donichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧だ。
examples.english: Government offices are closed on weekends.

examples.japanese: {官公庁|かんこうちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{複雑|ふくざつ}→複雑：01115_fukuzatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Procedures at government offices are often complex and time-consuming.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal term used in administrative, legal, and business contexts. {官|かん} refers to national government and {公|こう} refers to local public bodies. Together, {官公庁|かんこうちょう} covers all levels of government.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {官公庁|かんこうちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧ (government office procedures)
- {官公庁|かんこうちょう}{向|む}け (for government agencies)
- {官公庁|かんこうちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勤|つと}める→勤める：00902_tsutomeru⟧ (to work at a government office)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{役所|やくしょ}→役所：06455_yakusho⟧: government office, city hall — more colloquial, usually local
- ⟦{省庁|しょうちょう}→省庁：13703_shouchou⟧: ministries and agencies — specifically central government
- ⟦{行政|ぎょうせい}{機関|きかん}→行政機関：30276_gyouseikikan⟧: administrative body — formal, broader term
